description: This file provides utility functions for image processing tasks, specifically focusing on placing and overlaying logos within images. It includes functions for applying opacity, fitting logos to given boxes with 'contain' or 'cover' modes, clamping and padding boxes within image boundaries, saving debug previews, and functions to place logos inside specified boxes or overlay logos with size and position constraints.

methods.name: Image.Image _apply_opacity(img: Image.Image, opacity: float)
methods.description: Adjusts the opacity of an RGBA image by enhancing its alpha channel.

methods.name: Image.Image _fit_logo(logo: Image.Image, box_w: int, box_h: int, fit_mode: str)
methods.description: Resizes the logo image to fit within specified dimensions using 'contain' or 'cover' mode while preserving aspect ratio.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,int,int] _clamp_box(x: int, y: int, w: int, h: int, img_w: int, img_h: int)
methods.description: Ensures a rectangle lies within image boundaries and has at least 1x1 size.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,int,int] _apply_padding(x: int, y: int, w: int, h: int, pad_pct: float, img_w: int, img_h: int)
methods.description: Applies symmetric inner padding to a rectangle based on a percentage of its size.

methods.name: None _save_debug_preview(base_rgba: Image.Image, x: int, y: int, w: int, h: int, placed_w: int, placed_h: int, out_path: Path)
methods.description: Creates and saves a debug image showing detection and placement rectangles.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] place_logo_in_box( base_image_path: Path, logo_path: Path, output_path: Path, *, box: Tuple[int, int, int, int], opacity: Optional[float] = None, fit_mode: Optional[str] = None, padding_pct: Optional[float] = None, debug_preview_path: Optional[Path] = None, )
methods.description: Places a logo within a specified bounding box in an image, resizing and padding as needed, and saves the result.

methods.name: None overlay_logo( base_image_path: Path, logo_path: Path, output_path: Path, *, position: Tuple[int, int] = (10, 10), scale: float = 0.2, opacity: float = None, max_logo_size_ratio: float = 0.4, target_box: Tuple[int, int, int, int] | None = None, )
methods.description: Overlays a logo onto a base image either within a specified target box (if provided) or at a position based on scale ratios, with size and opacity constraints.
